sections.heading: Discounting is not a conversion strategy.
sections.description: The trading calendar has taught shoppers here to wait. When a storefront doesn't make the case for a product at full price, the promotion has to — and margin pays for it. We redesign Shopify stores so the buying argument sits on the page, not in the discount code.
sections.mobileDescription: From design to performance, we shape your Shopify store into a growth engine that brings in buyers and keeps them coming back.

cards.title: Full-price conversion as the objective
cards.description: Every design decision is judged on whether it helps a considered buyer commit without a code. Promotions then become a growth lever rather than the only working one.

cards.title: The phone as the primary storefront
cards.description: Product hierarchy, delivery information and checkout are resolved at 390px first, then expanded. Most themes do the reverse, which is where the conversion gap originates.

cards.title: Built for a team that trades through peak
cards.description: Modular sections, documented naming and a theme your marketing team can re-merchandise without a deployment — because the trading calendar does not wait for a sprint.

sections.heading: A catalogue that read as a database, rebuilt to sell.
sections.description: You focus on growing your brand. We'll handle your entire Shopify presence—from a stunning UI/UX redesign to full technical management.
sections.mobileDescription: See how we turn ordinary Shopify stores into polished, high-performing experiences built for real business growth.

items.question: Does the store remain live throughout the project?
items.answer: Yes. We work around your existing store to keep it live and minimise disruption throughout the project.

items.question: Can the work be timed around peak trading?
items.answer: Absolutely. We can plan key releases and updates around your busiest trading periods and important campaigns.

items.question: How is a redesign priced?
items.answer: Pricing depends on the scope, complexity, and level of support required. We define everything clearly before the project begins.

items.question: Does this require a new theme or a replatform?
items.answer: Not necessarily. We assess your current setup first and recommend the approach that makes the most sense for your business.

items.question: What happens to our existing apps and integrations?
items.answer: We review your existing ecosystem and make sure essential apps and integrations continue working smoothly after the redesign.

items.question: What is the impact on SEO?
items.answer: SEO is considered throughout the project. We protect existing rankings while improving the technical and content foundations of your store.

items.question: Can you work alongside our developer?
items.answer: Yes. We can work directly with your existing developers and collaborate with your team throughout the project.

items.question: How does an offshore team operate in practice?
items.answer: We work as an extension of your team with clear communication, shared workflows, regular updates, and defined responsibilities.
